svg.aria-label: Three panels: the back of the trail map with five board columns and a smear over the missing two; the museum pamphlet carrying the mirrored offset of those two columns alongside its printed rules; and the two lined up, showing the complete board and the king's three-move escape
svg.text: Five columns survive. The right strip lifted off.
Grid lines run into the stain, so the gap is visible.
Assume the strip empty and you get 18 routes, not one.
The reverse panel is blank, so the offset reads
through the paper when flipped — mirrored twice.
Grid lines continue — only one alignment works.
D4 → F4 → F7 → G7 — the only three-move escape.
Legs measure 2, 3 and 1. Code 231, nothing printed on the board.
